Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — roles, tech check, and attendee RSVPs

Hi Samir / Tina —

Thanks again for the time last week. To keep the timeline tight for your Q4 rollout, we want to kick off the MAP next week and get everyone aligned on scope, success criteria, and owner-level commitments. Proposed meeting:

- When: Thu, Oct 22 • 10:00–11:00 PT (45 min MAP + 15 min tech check)
- Where: Zoom (link to follow)
- Goal: Confirm MAP milestones, evaluation plan owners, and immediate blockers so we can lock the SOW and scheduling cadence.

Quick asks:
1) Please confirm attendee list + who will own evaluation (model/eval data) and procurement sign-off.
2) If there are any mandatory security folks who must join, flag them — we can add a separate SOC 2 evidence runbook session.

I’ve attached a one-page agenda draft and an initial MAP timeline for your review (MAP_agenda_v1.pdf).

Attendees from our side: Monica (CS lead, MAP ops), Karthik (Solutions, eval plan), Lauren (Account exec).

If that time doesn’t work, suggest two alternatives and we’ll re-run invites.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—Michael

Quick note on owners:
- Evaluation (model accuracy / regression): Samir — please confirm whether your team will provide a static eval set or if we should stage a live run against a shadow endpoint. Either works but we need to lock format (JSONL) + sample size (suggest 2k queries).
- Production readiness checklist: Lauren and I will own the rollout gating (latency SLOs, monitoring hooks).

Samir — if the eval set contains PHI, we’ll need to confirm the Private/secure path in the MAP and set a short call with Security. If not, we can proceed on the hosted test.

Also added two small asks to the agenda: 1) define a decision owner for model acceptance; 2) confirm expected cutover week (BlueHarbor Q4 target).

On the tech-check: I’ll join for the final 15 to validate screen share and recording works.

—Karthik
